text:
Incident Bot: [ALERT] high 5xx rate detected on dedicated-zekra-prod (eu-west-2). 5xx ratio 47% over last 5m. Affected endpoints: /api/v1/generate, /api/v1/chat. Paging oncall. thread:1715009999

Ajay P: taking this — oncall switching to me now. pinging Zekra contacts.

Sara M: thanks Ajay. quick summary for status page + customer email would be great. Zekra is enterprise, we need tailored comms and PD contact list.

Oncall-Emma: handing off to Ajay — see KV cache error popped at 03:13 UTC, logs show a downstream connection pool exhaustion to the serving runtime. I've attached the initial logs snapshot in the alert.

Ajay P: confirmed. I see a surge of FailedAllocation errors from worker-12 leading to 502/503. Rolling restart of the worker pool to isolate. Starting mitigation now. ETA 10m for first validation.

Lina R: @Ajay P please note SLA class: Zekra - enterprise platinum, dedicated instance, primary region eu-west-2. We'll need the tailored customer notify and include account manager in cc: am-zekra@redwood.ai.

Zekra-CSL: we already have complaints — their SupportOps pinged account team asking if this is a product regression. They want an ETA and whether data was affected.

Ajay P: mitigation steps: 1) drain worker-12 and restart 2) increase connection pool limit temporarily 3) if restart doesn't reduce 5xx, failover to warm spare variant (dedicated-zekra-prod-bak). Initiating step 1 now.

Sara M: drafting status page entry and customer email below. Please validate facts (region, affected endpoints, ETA, mitigation) before I post.

Sara M: STATUS PAGE - DRAFT (post once Ajay confirms mitigation progress):

```
Incident: Errors affecting Zekra dedicated instance (dedicated-zekra-prod)
Impact: Elevated 5xx errors for API requests to /api/v1/generate and /api/v1/chat causing failed requests and degraded response times for Zekra customers.
Scope: Dedicated cluster serving Zekra production traffic in eu-west-2
Start time: 2026-03-15T03:12:00Z
Current status: Mitigation in progress (rolling restart of worker pool and connection pool tuning).
Next update: in 15 minutes or when mitigation completes.

If you are a Zekra engineer or admin and see continued issues, contact your AM at am-zekra@redwood.ai or our enterprise support on +1-800-REDWOOD.
```

Lina R: looks good. Add "no customer data has been modified or exfiltrated" if Security gives the all-clear.

Security-Bot: quick scan completed; no suspicious access patterns detected. No evidence of data exfiltration as of 03:22 UTC. Recommend including the safety line after Ajay confirms root cause is internal resource exhaustion.

Ajay P: restart completed on worker-12, connection pool bumped from 100->200. 5xx ratio dropping (currently 9%). Running tail of requests; warming cache. Holding for 10 minutes to confirm stability.

Sara M: drafting tailored email to Zekra stakeholders — please sign off.

Sara M: EMAIL DRAFT - TO: ops@zekra.com; CC: am-zekra@redwood.ai, support-enterprise@redwood.ai

Subject: Redwood Inference — service impact on dedicated-zekra-prod (eu-west-2) — ongoing mitigation

Body:
Hi Zekra team,

We are investigating elevated error rates affecting your dedicated instance (dedicated-zekra-prod) in eu-west-2 that began at approximately 03:12 UTC. A subset of API requests to /api/v1/generate and /api/v1/chat returned 5xx errors causing some failed requests and increased latency.

What we're doing right now:
- Performing rolling restart of affected worker(s) and increasing connection pool limits to alleviate resource exhaustion.
- Monitoring traffic and error rates; failover to warm spare cluster prepared if necessary.
- Security scan completed; no indications of data access outside expected patterns.

What this means for you:
- Some requests may have failed or taken longer to complete between 03:12–03:25 UTC.
- We do not believe any customer data was modified or exposed.

Next update: we will update at 03:40 UTC or when mitigation completes. If you need urgent updates, reply to this thread or contact your account manager (am-zekra@redwood.ai).

Apologies for the disruption — we will follow up with a post-incident summary once we've completed the investigation.

Best,
Sara M
Redwood Inference — Incident Response
```

Oncall-Emma: small note — include request IDs sample and timeframe if they ask for forensic logs.

Ajay P: agreed. storing logs for 30 days for Zekra per contract. will attach sample request IDs in postmortem.

Zekra-CSL: thanks — forwarding to their SRE lead. They asked whether the dedicated fallback will cause a switched traffic window; requested planned blackhole time if failover happens.

Ajay P: can do controlled failover if needed, will coordinate with Zekra SRE. For now holding; current metrics look stable (5xx < 1% over last 3m).

Sara M: posting status page now with the drafted content and scheduling the customer email to go out in 2 minutes (to include current mitigation status).

Incident Bot: [UPDATE] status page post published for incident 1715009999. Customer email queued and will send in 2 minutes.

Lina R: heads-up to CS and AM teams: please be available for potential call if Zekra escalates.

Ajay P: will keep monitoring for next 30m, will update here if any regression.

Sara M: internal handoff template (for oncall -> escalation to Eng Ops):

```
Handoff summary: incident id 1715009999, affected customer: Zekra, instance: dedicated-zekra-prod, start: 03:12 UTC, mitigation: restarted worker pool, conn pool +100, current 5xx <1%, next steps: monitor 30m -> if >2% for 5m then failover to dedicated-zekra-prod-bak, AM/CS notified.
Contact list: am-zekra@redwood.ai; ops@zekra.com; SRE lead: srl-zekra@example.com; account manager: am-zekra@redwood.ai
Documentation links: runbook/dedicated-fallback, runbook/connpool-tuning
```

Oncall-Emma: handoff noted. Good job everyone.

Ajay P: incident closed to monitoring at 03:36 UTC. Will file postmortem and attach log snippets & request IDs.

Sara M: sending the post-incident email template and PR for the status page update to ops-comm channel once postmortem is ready.

Incident Bot: [RESOLVE] monitoring only — incident 1715009999 moved to resolved->monitoring.

Zekra-CSL: thanks team, Zekra accepted the summary and asked for the postmortem with timeline ASAP.

Sara M: noted — will circulate within 48 hours.
